name: hypermesh-cae-agent
description: Auditable HyperMesh 17 vehicle-door pre-processing with review-gated connectors.

interface.longDescription: Starts a local HyperMesh MCP service and supplies stage-gated, auditable vehicle-door CAD-to-CAE guidance with a unified point-weld, adhesive, and RBE2 review panel.
defaultPrompt: Check the HyperMesh CAE environment and prepare an auditable run.
Open the unified connector review panel, scan point welds, adhesive, and RBE2 candidates, and do not create connections before review.
Review the current CAE run artifacts and identify the next safe stage.
